# Image release

> Builds, signs and pushes the images of the Platform, Knovas Link and the sync component from a branch a person picks, so that a deployment names each image by its digest.

## Identity

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Id | L2-IMAGE-RELEASE |
| Kind | infrastructure |
| Owner | ROLE-ENGINE-OWNER |
| Status | planned |
| Level | 2 |

### Source paths

- .github/workflows/release-images.yml
- scripts/ci/release_image.sh

## Purpose

### Responsible for

| Id | Statement | Code |
|---|---|---|
| L2-IMAGE-RELEASE/R-1 | Builds each chosen image from the run's commit with the image's own Dockerfile, without the layer cache. | .github/workflows/release-images.yml |
| L2-IMAGE-RELEASE/R-2 | Pushes the image under two moving tags and signs and verifies the pushed digest keylessly. | .github/workflows/release-images.yml |
| L2-IMAGE-RELEASE/R-3 | Names, per image, the package, the build context and the two tags (release_image.sh). | scripts/ci/release_image.sh |

### Not responsible for

- Deploying an image; a deployment names the digest the run's summary prints.
- What goes into an image; each image's Dockerfile belongs to its component.

## Offers

### Operations

| Id | Name | Entrance | Ref |
|---|---|---|---|
| release-images | Workflow release-images, started by hand (workflow_dispatch) on a branch, input images: all, platform, site, knovas-link or sync-component | job | .github/workflows/release-images.yml |
| release-image-helper | release_image.sh IMAGE OWNER BRANCH COMMIT, prints package, repository, context, runner, short_tag and branch_tag as KEY=value lines | cli | scripts/ci/release_image.sh |

### `release-images`

#### Needs

| Id | Statement | Risk class | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| L2-IMAGE-RELEASE/release-images/N-1 | Started by hand on a branch (refs/heads/...); a run started from anything else builds nothing. | standard | kind: test, ref: KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/tests/test_release_images_workflow.py, checks: test_started_by_hand_only_with_a_choice_of_images; test_any_branch_and_every_choice_maps_to_images |
| L2-IMAGE-RELEASE/release-images/N-2 | The repository secret KB_READ_TOKEN is set for the Platform and the sync component, whose images install brain-runner; without it those jobs fail before they build. | standard | kind: test, ref: KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/tests/test_release_images_workflow.py, checks: test_the_token_reaches_the_build_as_a_secret_and_is_required |

#### Promises

| Id | Statement | Risk class | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| L2-IMAGE-RELEASE/release-images/P-1 | Each chosen image is built from the run's commit with --pull --no-cache; KB_READ_TOKEN reaches the build only as a BuildKit secret, and the job fails when the token is in the image's history or git configuration, or when brain-runner is not importable in an image that needs it. | critical | kind: test, ref: KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/tests/test_release_images_workflow.py, checks: test_the_token_reaches_the_build_as_a_secret_and_is_required |
| L2-IMAGE-RELEASE/release-images/P-2 | The image is pushed as ghcr.io/OWNER/PACKAGE:SHORT_TAG (the first 12 characters of the commit) and :BRANCH_TAG, both naming the digest the registry answered; a different digest fails the job. | standard | kind: test, ref: KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/tests/test_release_images_workflow.py, checks: test_the_push_reads_the_digest_and_both_tags_name_it |
| L2-IMAGE-RELEASE/release-images/P-3 | The pushed digest is signed keylessly with a checksum-pinned cosign and verified against this run's workflow identity, commit and trigger before the summary is written. | critical | kind: test, ref: KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/tests/test_release_images_workflow.py, checks: test_cosign_is_pinned_and_the_digest_signed_and_verified |
| L2-IMAGE-RELEASE/release-images/P-4 | The run's summary names, per image, the image by digest, the branch, the commit and the line a deployment sets (DOCBRIDGE_WEB_IMAGE, KNOVAS_LINK_DIGEST or SYNC_COMPONENT_DIGEST). | standard | kind: test, ref: KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/tests/test_release_images_workflow.py, checks: test_the_summary_names_digest_branch_and_commit |

#### Limits

| Id | Statement | Risk class | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| L2-IMAGE-RELEASE/release-images/L-1 | One job per image, 60 minutes each, on a single-use runner (CI_EPHEMERAL_RUNNER) or a GitHub-hosted one, never the shared runner; permissions only contents: read, packages: write, id-token: write. | critical | kind: test, ref: KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/tests/test_release_images_workflow.py, checks: test_single_use_runners_never_the_shared_box; test_permissions_are_minimal |
| L2-IMAGE-RELEASE/release-images/L-2 | GitHub offers the workflow only once its file is on the default branch; a branch without the file cannot be released by it. | low |  |

#### Needs

|---|---|---|---|

| L2-IMAGE-RELEASE/release-image-helper/P-2 | The branch tag is a valid Docker tag of at most 128 characters; a branch that reads like a commit gets the prefix branch-, so it never shadows a commit tag. | low | kind: test, ref: KnovasPlatform/components/docbridge_integration/tests/test_release_images_workflow.py, checks: test_the_branch_tag_is_a_valid_docker_tag |

## Uses

| Component | Expects | Method |
|---|---|---|
| L3-KNOVAS-LINK | KnovasLink/Dockerfile builds the knovas-link image, and `import knovas_link` gives its VERSION. | docker build of the component's folder |
| L3-SYNC-COMPONENT | KnovasPlatform/components/sync_component/Dockerfile builds the sync-component image and installs brain-runner from the kb_read_token build secret. | docker build of the component's folder |
| L2-BRAIN-BUILDER | The site package the Builder writes names the images knovas-link and sync-component (builder/sites.py CONTAINERS), the package names release_image.sh pushes; a test compares them, no code reads them across the boundary. | names shared by convention, checked by test_the_image_names_are_the_ones_the_deployment_uses |
